title: Check zero-grade chart moves and expose empty-helper compiler failures
body:
Equal physical projectors and a common coordinate encoding give a no-MOVE boundary. An explicit nonaliasing cochart rewrite restores a dirty sentinel and preserves the 680-row scalar maps both ways under this binding. One proposed global merger breaks two nesting constraints. Another reverses 15 old containments and gives full signed change about −2141.27694012. The pinned empty-axis and missing-helper compilation paths also fail on concrete controls.

## Task and overlap

The finite interface is #7914 `46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a`. Prior #7912 neutral specialization and #7974 original-pulse closure delete owners under different conditions. This refines the current geometric regrading scope by checking a needed physical boundary. The scoped task is the #7852 follow-up at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, based on `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` and #7830 `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. The archive gives exact source identities and complete assumptions.

## Validation

Check SHA256SUMS and run `python3 -I -B verify.py` from a clean extraction. The source-bound local retiming, dirty escrow, both exact symbolic operators, directed tariff, changed source incidences, and compiler and ownership corruption controls all pass.

## Open next questions

A genuinely admissible identification needs common physical coordinate binding and explicit zero-extent owner lifecycle or prior specialization. Qualify all remaining retirements, finite stock, precision and outer recovery.
